description: Update web-console, swarm-manager queue, cron, and CLI spawn surfaces to populate `Run.ConversationID` and `Run.ParentRunID` directly, rather than relying on the inheritance fallback. Cross-cuts other repos. Also covers DB read-time normalization for legacy persisted runs that still carry `Acceptance.AutoApprove==true` / `RequiresApproval` (per the plan's Risks table).
name: agent-manager-spawn-surface-conversation-id-population
title: Populate Run.ConversationID / Run.ParentRunID at all spawn surfaces
